ACTION.title:
Used to define which
type of update you want
to do
ACTION.description:
Two possible values :

1. CREATE_IF_NOT_EXISTS :
Used to create a
new line even if there
is already an existing
line in the PO for the
same PRODUCT. If the
line already exists with
the same quantity, it
will be ignored.This
action is used by
default if ACTION field
is empty.

2. CREATE_OR_UPDATE :
Used to update an
existing line for the
same PRODUCT with a
new quantity or unit. If
the line doesn't exist in
the PO, it will be
created.
If the line already
exists but an
inspection is scheduled
or started on it, a new
line will be created.
